Step 2: Rule 8 – All white things are kind.  
 From Bob is white (Step 1) we infer Bob is kind.

Step 3: Rule 7 – Kind things are furry.  
 From Bob is kind (Step 2) we infer Bob is furry.

We have derived that Bob is furry. Therefore the statement “Bob is not furry” is contradicted by the derived fact; it is not forced to be true.

ANSWER: False
